patterns: The outage wave was the biggest story: 18 hits (~3.05M views) at a 0.6% like rate. Chase explains the outage ~529k, 'four big banks reporting WIDESPREAD outages' ~208k, United 'widespread system outage' (alx ~84k, Gunther ~63k), DHS Sec. Mullin '98% certain not a cyberattack' ~42k, and the FEMA alert test ~60k. Big reach, few likes, same as the ground-stop weekend

'Nov 17 global blackout' doom posts did huge reach with almost no likes: Gunther's '@grok, if a real nationwide blackout hit tomorrow...' was #1 at ~1.51M (0.2%), 'The day the world supposedly goes dark' ~221k (1.0%), 'watch the birds' ~89k. People click on fear, but they don't endorse it

'Hey @grok' questions were 9 hits (~2.67M) at 0.2%: the blackout question (~1.51M), '50 states fight it out' ~718k, best tap water ~121k, Mount Rushmore secret room ~116k. Still the most reliable reach format, with the lowest like rate

Short, punchy lines got the most likes: 'Planes are on the runway, banks are crashing… But electronic voting machines are safe' ~210k at 12.2%, 'Audit EVERY vote' ~31k at 10.8%, Thune 'useless coward' ~28k at 6.9%. Joke-plus-outage beat the outage alerts by 20x on like rate

Faith and tribute posts had the best like rates of the day: the prayer for Trump's trip ~255k at 11.6%, oldest Pearl Harbor survivor Freeman Johnson dies at 106 ~164k at 11.0%, Mike Rowe's Trump story on Maher ~186k at 10.5%. Religion/Islam posts (4 hits, ~505k) ran 11.8%

Trump's Asia trip (Quad in Manila, Thailand deal, Kim Jong Un, 'fire Rubio' joke) was 16 hits (~798k) at 2.2%. The 'Quad SUPERINTELLIGENCE ACCELERATOR' (~97k) and critical minerals deals (~111k) crossed politics with AI
rawsalerts posted no originals in this window. alx had 18, led by the United outage (~84k) and 'Major U.S. banks (and Microsoft) are down' (~35k)
virals_narrative: The outsider AI sweep (last ~48h, 49 posts) was a quiet one, with nothing past ~55k. The top posts were @stark0xbt's thread on Gavin Baker's question to Jensen Huang before he left Nvidia (~53k), @RoundtableSpace's list of last month's model launches (~42k), and @testingcatalog's daily AI briefs (~27k on Qwen4-Max; ~13k forecasting MAI-Code-2 today and GPT-6.2 this week). The money side was AI-bubble talk: @LeifInvests' AI infrastructure stocks (~12k), @tengyanAI on circular financing and 'the AI bubble has burst' fears (~9k), and smaller posts saying the bubble is popping in credit markets first. Open lane: a report that California's attorney general cited OpenAI agents going rogue 80+ times in testing in a lawsuit got almost no reach (@lunkertw ~120 views). Combined with Trump's Quad superintelligence announcement, AI-policy-meets-politics is still wide open for Patriot Punisher.
narrative_synthesis: A Monday-to-Tuesday window: 197 hits from 198 originals, ~10.9M views, and no rawsalerts originals. Outages took over again: Chase, BofA, Wells Fargo, U.S. Bank, United and Microsoft went down, on the same day the internet had picked for a 'global blackout.' The doom framing got the reach (Gunther's @grok blackout question ~1.51M) but almost no likes. The likes went to jokes about the outages ('but voting machines are safe' 12.2%), faith posts and tributes (11-12%). Takeaway: on outage days, post the calm checklist or a sharp one-liner. Leave the panic headline alone, since it gets clicks but no endorsement.
